# spatial-structures.types: Quadtree2D

**Status:** Supported (tier `geometry`). In a shipping tier; the lint, type-check, and code-generation gates cover it. No release promises its signature yet.

## Summary

> A quadtree (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Quadtree) over a square 2D region.
> Node 0 is the root and covers Bounds; each level splits its square into four
> equal quadrants, to at most MaxDepth levels below the root. No builder yet:
> instances come from a host, until BuildOctree
> (spatial-structures.library.plato) gains a 2D twin.
